title: HomeoDynamic
description: Simple sprite changes for the mod Homeostatic.
body:
[Homeostatic](https://modrinth.com/mod/homeostatic) is a tempature and thirst mod that I adore and always use when making a pack where i'd like a little more of a survival challenge (check it out!), but maybe you want a little bit of a refresh to the sprites of the mod? That's exactly what this pack does! HomeoDynamic changes some of the spritework within Homeostatic to a different style while also moving to a slightly more limited colour palette.

Examples:
![In-game item sprite changes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1656eca06b9f6cc6ce70564f98ffd6696ed4a493.png)
![GUI sprite changes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b2a74258dab81f1247222094b49bf62b66e5900a.png)


Very early version, changes are most likely in the future.
